diagnostics.probe1: Same Windows synthetic launch with repaired recorder.
diagnostics.probe2: Only after an actionable probe1 finding: freeze one minimal evidence-linked revision and replay. If probe1 passed, skip or use a predeclared negative evidence-retention fixture.
diagnostics.probe3: Only after a distinct actionable remaining cause: freeze the second and final revision and replay; otherwise skip.
diagnostics.continuation: Classified failure consumes a slot and may continue within this task. No unchanged blind retry. Opaque failure or missing evidence closes task.
diagnostics.boundary: No blanket descendant permission. Accept any wrapper only after measured image, creation identity, ancestry, command-role and runtime equivalence evidence; preserve production process/import restrictions.

recorder: Checkpoint before each operation; fixed reason codes for launch, ownership, handshake, runtime fields, image, command, payload and cleanup. Preserve normalized observations immediately, including unresolved roles. Record primary and cleanup failures separately; every attempt gets a receipt.
privacy: Before scratch cleanup, retain bounded exact mismatch/traceback evidence as declared local-only failure deliverables. Public allowlist contains reason codes, boolean field checks, normalized roles, allowed image hashes and counters only. No private paths, process identifiers, commands or tracebacks. Never export private deliverables. Reap/join before removing scratch; cleanup rejection stops alternate deletion attempts.
acceptance: After normal diagnostic launch succeeds, freeze final sources/runtime/fixtures. Run normal launch, undeclared child rejection, output cap+1 rejection, known nonzero exit, cancellation/deadline exactly once in order. Require correct classified outcomes, preserved evidence, reaped owned chain, joined readers and cleaned scratch. No patches or retries after suite starts.
stop: Stop on ownership/identity ambiguity, uncontrolled process creation, privacy export failure, budget/deadline excess, cleanup failure, opaque diagnostic failure, exhausted diagnostic/revision budget, or first unexpected acceptance outcome. Also stop if repair requires global system changes, weakened restrictions, scientific access or historical source/evidence edits. Do not automatically start another equivalent repair stage.
exclusions: Zero raw scientific/model reads, inference, training, GPU, engine transitions, new games, historical reruns, strategy changes or broad audits. Success accepts only synthetic launcher/evidence behavior; no scientific re-entry. Agent Workflow disabled.
root_adjudication: Accept one40-minute evidence-led engineering task, instead of repeated blind single-probe stages. This is new synthetic scope; no prior attempt is refunded.
First prove failure recording with in-process fault injection at every declared phase; distinguish primary and cleanup failure. Freeze relevant source and review before first OS diagnostic.
Allow at most3 diagnostic launches and2 cause-linked revisions inside this one budget. No unchanged retries, generic Python descendant permission or presumed runtime equivalence.

Permit declared bounded private failure deliverables locally before scratch cleanup. Publication remains an explicit sanitized allowlist; no private paths, process IDs, command text or traceback export.
Final acceptance is frozen once and run once; the first unexpected outcome closes it. A pass permits no scientific rerun, training or default change.

If this task again cannot retain actionable evidence or cannot resolve the bounded blocker, do not automatically create another equivalent repair stage. Reassess the genuine blocking condition and the persistent-goal blocked-turn rule.

Registered read budget includes source/metadata/runtime identities and independent review; implementation browsing/Git/public privacy checks remain within the40-minute wall budget. No scientific data access in any category.
